First Interstate Bank Has Decreased Apple (AAPL) Position; Bank Of America Lowered Its Ericsson (ERIC) Stake 
March 7, 2018 - By Darrin Black 
Bank Of America Corp decreased Ericsson (ERIC) stake by 16.62% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Bank Of America Corp sold 261,899 shares as Ericsson (ERIC)’s stock rose 10.57%. The Bank Of America Corp holds 1.31M shares with $7.56 million value, down from 1.58M last quarter. Ericsson now has $22.09B valuation. The stock decreased 1.47% or $0.1   $6.69. About 2.17M shares traded. Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson (NASDAQ:ERIC) has declined 12.25% since March 7, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.95% the S&P500. 
First Interstate Bank decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 9.81% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. First Interstate Bank sold 12,058 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 12.78%. The First Interstate Bank holds 110,904 shares with $17.09 million value, down from 122,962 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $889.07 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.82% or $1.45   $175.22. About 8.81M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   45.78% the S&P500. 
Since October 3, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 5 selling transactions for $26.38 million activity. The insider Riccio Daniel J. sold $2.42 million. Another trade for 63,388 shares valued at $9.78 million was made by AHRENDTS ANGELA J on Tuesday, October 3. SCHILLER PHILIP W sold 56,808 shares worth $8.79 million. 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.73 in 2017 Q3. Its up 0.03, from 0.7 in 2017Q2. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Berkshire Money Management invested in 0.07% or 1,485 shares. Ntv Asset Management Limited Liability Company holds 37,301 shares or 1.67% of its portfolio. First Interstate Bank increased Jp Morgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) stake by 10,764 shares to 163,635 valued at $15.63 million in 2017Q3. It also upped Ishares (EEM) stake by 23,144 shares and now owns 52,564 shares. Union Pacific Corp (NYSE:UNP) was raised too.

The stock has “Buy” rating by Global Equities Research on Tuesday, August 25. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Piper Jaffray given on Wednesday, October 28. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) earned “Buy” rating by BTIG Research on Tuesday, February 13. Goldman Sachs maintained it with “Buy” rating and $136 target in Wednesday, April 27 report. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Monday, November 6 with “Buy” rating. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $120 target in Wednesday, April 27 report.
